hierarchy.observation: Exit to My Voyages appears near the top, separate from Return to Chronicle. The Library title wraps without obscuring the search and active-list labels. The returned passage and objective are distinct.

typography.observation: Voyage and reading headings use cream serif typography. Smaller context and state labels remain readable, and the returned Follow the lanterns title fits the page.

spacing.observation: Companion content and library filters fit a single column with visible separation. At return the Journal tools and sticky objective bar reduce the lower first-viewport page area, leaving the actual title and lead visible.

controls.observation: Exit to My Voyages and Return to Chronicle appear as distinct, tappable rows. The route selects Continue Adventure from the Library and lands on visible Journal tools plus Continue Voyage.

contrast.observation: Account, contextual actions and the focus outline are visible on dark teal. Dark ink on parchment and labeled maroon Journal tabs remain distinguishable from the gold continuation action.

consistency.observation: The teal shell, identity and labels continue across the companion and Library, while parchment and gold continuity cues distinguish the Journal proper.

states.observation: Both modes show populated companion, ordinary Library and returned Journal. Normal shows the scrolled passage with paging controls and reduced shows the readable single-page fallback with the current heading.

responsive.observation: At 390px the Library uses stack order and a two-line heading. The companion return and contextual exit retain useful width and the Journal tabs fit above Continue Voyage without clipping the current heading.

keyboard.observation: The keyboard-driven escape and re-entry sequence exposes the named controls and clear Library focus before landing back on the Journal. Both recordings show the same underlying destination.

focus.observation: My Chronicle Library receives a full clear outline in both modes. Focus indication is kept within the visible phone layout and no pairing overlay remains on the Journal return.

feedback.observation: My Chronicle Library shows Server confirmed and the active Voyage. Re-entry restores Follow the lanterns and the named objective. Exact visible feedback measurements are 74.28 to 260.42ms across the two motion contexts within the 5000ms budget.

motion.observation: The normal recording uses animated page staging as it reopens the Journal; reduced reaches the same reading task through the readable fallback, with the same contextual exit and Library path.

continuity.observation: The same visible account and synthetic Voyage carry from phone companion through the active entry to Follow the lanterns. The logged capture verifies the canonical same-Voyage path at return.

complexity.observation: The narrow companion offers only one contextual library exit and a separate direct return. Search, state and sort remain ordinary Library controls and do not replace adventure re-entry.

role-outcomes.observation: The signed-in Player reaches My Voyages, reopens the same active adventure and regains readable passage, Journal tools and actual Continue Voyage control.

fallbacks.observation: Reduced motion uses an explicit readable Journal fallback with Follow the lanterns and Continue Voyage still available. The mobile companion can always return through the visible contextual or direct route.
